caption: The drawing features a single, clear glass bowl positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The bowl has a round, wide opening with a thick rim, and its surface is elaborately cut with geometric diamond and triangular patterns. The glass material is depicted with detailed shading to show its reflective and transparent properties. The base of the bowl is solid, faceted, and broader than the stem, providing stability. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the drawing. Near the bottom right of the image, there is a handwritten name, “Carl Buergerniss.”
title: Salt Cellar
